typography.headings: Poppins, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif. Use for all display and H1-H4 headings. Must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headers.
typography.body: system-ui, sans-serif. Default to text-base for standard readability.
typography.eyebrow_labels: Teal-caps eyebrow labels above each H2. Implementation: `Eyebrow Text`

dark_mode_strategy.strategy: Tailwind dark mode via class toggle (e.g. `dark:` modifier on `<html>`). Provide a theme toggle button in the Header next to auth buttons.
dark_mode_strategy.hero_section: Light Mode: bg-[#1F3F5B] (navy). Dark Mode: bg-slate-950 (near-black).

alternating_bands.band_A: Light Mode: bg-slate-50 (#F8FAFC) / Dark Mode: bg-slate-900
alternating_bands.band_B: Light Mode: bg-white / Dark Mode: bg-slate-800

dark_mode_strategy.wave_colors: Waves must use `fill-current` and receive their color via Tailwind `text-` utility matching the NEXT section's background (e.g. `text-slate-50 dark:text-slate-900`).
dark_mode_strategy.text: Light Mode: text-slate-900 / Dark Mode: text-slate-100

visual_enhancers.wave_dividers: Subtle single-curve dividers between major sections. Use inline SVGs. Example: `<svg viewBox="0 0 1440 120" preserveAspectRatio="none" className="w-full h-auto min-h-[40px] max-h-[120px] fill-current"><path d="M0,70 C240,120 480,15 720,60 C960,105 1200,15 1440,60 L1440,120 L0,120 Z"></path></svg>`. Must scale full-bleed without stretch artifacts.
visual_enhancers.round_logo_motif: In the hero section of the landing page, include the round logo (`/icon-512.png`) as a floating badge or integrated design element. Should reflow/drop on mobile.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-md. Primary CTAs use sun/orange (bg-smn-orange), secondary use ghost or teal.

header.behavior: Sticky. On `/` (Landing page), starts as transparent (bg-transparent) and text-white. On scroll (e.g. > 50px), transitions to solid background (Light: bg-white text-slate-900, Dark: bg-slate-950 text-white). On inner pages, always solid.
header.logo: Use the horizontal logo. Ensure `LOGO_COLOR` is used on light solid headers, and `LOGO_HORIZONTAL_DARK` on dark solid headers or transparent headers over the dark hero.

section_rhythm.landing: Hero (Navy) -> Wave (inherit Band A) -> Band A (What is SMN) -> Wave (inherit Band B) -> Band B (Features/Grid) -> etc.
section_rhythm.public_pages: `/pricing`, `/contact`, `/community-hub`, `/@handle`, `/directory` must adopt the same rhythm: start with a dark-navy header/mini-hero block, transition with a wave SVG to off-white body content.

responsive_breakpoints.mobile: ≤430px. Stack columns, reflow hero. Wave-divider SVGs must scale full-bleed. Round-logo motif can drop.
responsive_breakpoints.tablet: 768px – 1024px. Grid switches to 2 columns where appropriate.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure teal and orange text/buttons have sufficient contrast against off-white and dark slate backgrounds. Use APCA guidelines.
accessibility.data_testid: CRITICAL: All existing `data-testid` attributes on ALL affected pages MUST remain untouched. Do not remove `login-btn`, `nav-boat pros`, `pricing-page`, `stripe-mode-banner`, `checkout-btn`, `contact-form`, `handle-profile-page`, `brand-logo`, etc.

instructions_to_main_agent: Identify the 6 public pages (`/`, `/pricing`, `/contact`, `/community-hub`, `/@handle`, `/directory`) and apply the marketing rhythm.
Do NOT touch authenticated app pages (`/dashboard`, `/messages`, `/feed`, `/events`, `/crew-bank`, `/profile`, `/reviews`, `/admin/*`).
Update Header.jsx to handle route-based and scroll-based transparency.
Implement dark mode toggle in the Header. Apply Tailwind dark mode classes (`dark:bg-slate-900`, etc.) to the 6 target pages.
Add inline SVG wave dividers at section transitions. The wave SVG should wrap in a block like `<div className="w-full overflow-hidden leading-none ...">` to prevent baseline gaps.
Preserve Poppins font for headings and system-ui for body.
Use existing CSS variables or extend them in index.css as necessary.
Never replace `LOGO_HORIZONTAL` or `LOGO_COLOR` image references with just text.
Ensure test-ids are meticulously preserved across refactors.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not remove functionality to achieve design. Add subtle entry animations for sections using Framer Motion or simple CSS transitions. Make sure to avoid absolute centering of main containers; left-align content where reading flow demands it. Keep component abstractions modular and reusable. Add transitions to interactive elements except transforms.
